flags.sourceSentence: At the end of the initial term, and at the end of each term thereafter, your membership renews automatically for a further twelve (12) month term at the then-current rate.
flags.consequence: Your membership renews automatically for another full 12-month term at the then-current rate, and if you miss the 3-day notice window your late notice only takes effect at the end of the following term, so you owe dues for that entire intervening term. A suspended, frozen or medically held membership keeps renewing on the same schedule, so you can be paying while unable to use the club.

flags.sourceSentence: To stop a renewal you must deliver written notice of cancellation to the Member Services desk no later than three (3) days before the renewal date.
flags.consequence: Missing the 3-day notice deadline commits the signer to a further full 12-month term at the then-current rate, and dues for that term are payable in full even if they stop using the gym; a suspended, frozen or medically held membership keeps renewing on the same schedule.

flags.sourceSentence: Meridian may amend the Club Rules, the Schedule of Fees, the hours of operation, the class timetable and the terms of this Agreement at any time by posting the amended version at the club or on the Meridian website, and the amended version applies to you from the date it is posted.
flags.consequence: Meridian can change the dues, the fees, the hours, the rules and the terms of this Agreement at any time, and the changes apply to the signer from the date of posting, with continued use treated as acceptance — so the price and conditions of the deal can shift mid-term without the signer's agreement.

flags.sourceSentence: Meridian’s total liability to you for any claim arising out of or relating to this Agreement, your membership or your use of any facility — whether the claim is framed in contract, in negligence or otherwise — will not exceed the total dues and fees you paid to Meridian in the twelve (12) months immediately before the event giving rise to the claim.
flags.consequence: Meridian's total liability for any claim — including negligence — is capped at the dues and fees you paid in the prior 12 months, and it is not liable at all for lost income, lost business opportunity, or loss of or damage to your property, including property left in a locker. If you suffer a serious injury or loss, your recovery from Meridian is limited to roughly one year of what you paid.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify, defend and hold harmless Meridian and its ofﬁcers, employees, instructors and contractors against any claim, demand, loss, liability or expense, including reasonable legal fees, that is brought by a third party and arises out of your use of the facilities, your conduct on club premises, the conduct of a guest you bring, or any service you provide to another member.
flags.consequence: The signer must cover Meridian's legal costs and any third-party claim arising from their use of the facilities, their conduct, a guest's conduct, or any service they provide to another member, with Meridian choosing the lawyer and controlling settlement — an open-ended obligation with no dollar cap.

flags.sourceSentence: For twelve (12) months after your Program candidacy ends for any reason, you will not teach, coach or deliver group ﬁtness instruction or personal training, whether as an employee, as a contractor or on your own account, at any facility within ﬁfteen (15) miles of a Meridian location at which you taught or trained.
flags.consequence: For 12 months after their candidacy ends, the signer cannot teach, coach or deliver fitness instruction or personal training — as employee, contractor or on their own account — within 15 miles of any Meridian location where they taught or trained, and cannot solicit Meridian members for outside instruction, which could block their income in that area and period.

flags.sourceSentence: Dues not received within ten (10) days of the draw date incur the late charge set out in the Schedule of Fees then in effect, which is posted at the Member Services desk and on the Meridian website and forms part of this Agreement.
flags.consequence: Late, returned-payment, keycard and reinstatement charges are set in a Schedule of Fees the signer has not been given in this document, so the amounts are unknown at signing and the signer authorises Meridian to draw all dues and charges from their payment method until the Agreement ends and the balance is nil.

flags.sourceSentence: Program enrolment renews on each anniversary of your Program start date at the then-current tuition.
flags.consequence: Program tuition renews automatically each anniversary at the then-current rate, and to stop it the signer must give written notice at least 90 days before the anniversary — missing that window means another year's tuition is billed, at a rate the signer cannot see in this document.

flags.sourceSentence: Any dispute, claim or controversy between you and Meridian arising out of or relating to this Agreement, your membership or the Program will be resolved by ﬁnal and binding arbitration administered by a nationally recognised arbitration provider under its consumer arbitration rules, and you and Meridian each waive any right to a trial by jury and any right to bring or participate in a class, collective or representative action.
flags.consequence: The signer gives up the right to a jury trial and to bring or join any class, collective or representative action against Meridian; disputes go to a single arbitrator whose award is final, and the arbitrator decides the scope of this clause. A 30-day written opt-out is available after first accepting the Agreement.

flags.sourceSentence: Access is by keycard or through the application, and you are responsible for every entry made with your keycard or your account.
flags.consequence: You are responsible for every entry made with your keycard or your account, so if your keycard or account is used by someone else — even without your permission — you bear the consequences of that entry. You must also notify Meridian in writing of any change to your contact, billing or emergency contact details within 10 days.

flags.sourceSentence: Where the Plot Holder gives notice, no refund is due, and the Plot Holder may harvest whatever is ready before the notice period runs out.
flags.consequence: If the plot holder ends the licence early, they forfeit the entire remaining season's fee — for example, giving notice in June means losing the fee for roughly five unused months, while the Association would owe a proportional refund if it gave the same notice.

flags.sourceSentence: Anything left after 15 December becomes the Association’s to keep or to clear.
flags.consequence: Any item the plot holder leaves on the plot after 15 December 2027 — canes, frames, tools or other belongings — becomes the Association's property to keep or dispose of, with no compensation.

flags.sourceSentence: On an annual plan the deadline to cancel is the day that falls thirty (30) days before the anniversary of the date you first subscribed, and where no cancellation is received by that day the term extends by a further twelve (12) months at the annual fee then in effect.
flags.consequence: On an annual plan, missing the cancellation deadline — the day thirty days before the subscription anniversary — automatically commits the signer to another full twelve-month term at whatever the annual fee is at that time, with no fresh signature.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify and hold Northwind harmless from any claim brought by a third party that relates to content you uploaded, exported or published through the service, including a claim that the content infringes a copyright, a trade mark or a right of privacy, and you will pay our reasonable legal costs of defending such a claim.
flags.consequence: The signer must pay Northwind's reasonable legal costs to defend any third-party claim connected to content they uploaded, exported or published — an open-ended obligation with no dollar cap that could exceed anything the signer paid for the service.

flags.sourceSentence: Any dispute between you and Northwind arising out of these terms or out of your use of the service will be settled by binding arbitration before a single arbitrator under the consumer rules of a recognised arbitration body, and you agree to bring any claim only in your individual capacity and not as a plaintiff or class member in any purported class, collective or representative proceeding.
flags.consequence: The signer gives up the right to sue in court or join a class action against Northwind; disputes go to binding individual arbitration, and the arbitrator's decision is final, so the signer cannot pursue a serious problem collectively or through a court (except small claims).

flags.sourceSentence: We may revise the fee for any plan, and a revised fee applies to you from the start of the first Billing Period that begins more than thirty (30) days after we send notice of the revision to the email address on your account.
flags.consequence: The company can raise the subscription price at any time, and the new fee applies automatically from the next Billing Period unless the signer cancels; the signer's only way to avoid the higher price is to leave.

flags.sourceSentence: Where a payment is not collected on its due date, interest accrues on the unpaid amount at one and one half percent (1.5%) per month from the due date until payment is received, and an account suspended for non-payment is subject to the reactivation charge published in the Fee Schedule on the Northwind support site.
flags.consequence: An expired card is treated as a failed payment, and after retries the account can be suspended; getting it back requires paying a reactivation charge whose amount is set in a Fee Schedule the signer has not been shown, plus 1.5% monthly interest on the unpaid amount.

flags.sourceSentence: We may amend these terms, the pricing page and the Fee Schedule at any time, an amended version takes effect when we post it at northwindstudio.example/terms, and your continued use of the service after it is posted is your acceptance of the amended version.
flags.consequence: The company can change the terms, pricing and Fee Schedule at any time by posting them on its website, and the signer is bound by the changes simply by continuing to use the service — including changes that add obligations or charges without individual notice.

flags.sourceSentence: Where availability in a calendar month falls below that figure, your remedy is the service credit set out in the Service Credit Policy and nothing further.
flags.consequence: If the service underperforms, the signer's only remedy is a service credit defined in a separate Service Credit Policy the signer has not been given, with no refund or other compensation available.

flags.sourceSentence: Northwind’s aggregate liability to you for every claim relating to the service, whether framed in contract, in tort, in warranty or otherwise — and including any claim arising from lost work, lost revenue or a failed export — will not exceed the amount you actually paid us under Section 2 for the Billing Period in which the claim arose.
flags.consequence: Northwind's total liability for anything related to the service — including lost work, lost revenue or a failed export — is limited to the amount the signer paid for the single Billing Period in which the claim arose, which could be far less than the actual loss.

flags.sourceSentence: Your subscription continues from one Billing Period into the next without further action by either of us, and we bill the plan fee then in effect on the first day of each new Billing Period.
flags.consequence: The subscription renews automatically from one Billing Period to the next with no action from the signer, who is billed the then-current fee each period; on a monthly plan the signer must cancel by the day before the period ends to stop the next charge.

flags.sourceSentence: A cancellation made on or after the first day of a Billing Period takes effect at the end of that Billing Period, and the fee already collected for it is not refunded.
flags.consequence: If the signer cancels on or after the first day of a Billing Period, they pay for the whole period and get no refund for the time they will not use.

flags.sourceSentence: For a period of twelve (12) months following the last day of your employment, whether that employment ends at your choice or at ours, you will not provide services that are the same as or substantially similar to those you provided to Ardent, whether as an employee, a consultant, a contractor, an adviser or a principal, to any business that develops, manufactures or sells a product within the Restricted Field as that term is defined in Exhibit B to this letter.
flags.consequence: For 12 months after employment ends — even if Ardent ends it — the signer cannot work in a similar role for any business in the 'Restricted Field', and cannot solicit Ardent employees or approach Ardent customers, distributors or contract manufacturers they dealt with, potentially blocking their main source of income in their field.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify Ardent and hold it harmless against any claim, loss, liability or expense, including reasonable attorney fees, that arises out of a breach by you of Section 4 or Section 5 of this letter, or out of a claim by a former employer that your employment with Ardent breaches an obligation you owe to them.
flags.consequence: The signer must personally pay Ardent's claims, losses and attorney fees arising from a breach of the confidentiality or non-compete sections, or from a former employer's claim that the new job breaches an obligation owed to that former employer — an open-ended amount the signer cannot cap in advance.

flags.sourceSentence: You and Ardent each agree that any claim arising out of or relating to your employment, its terms, or its end, including any statutory claim, will be resolved by final and binding arbitration administered under the employment rules of a nationally recognised arbitration provider, on an individual basis only, and each of us waives any right to a jury trial and any right to participate in a class, collective or representative action.
flags.consequence: The signer gives up the right to go to court with a jury and the right to join a class or collective action for any employment-related claim, including statutory claims, and must instead pursue claims alone in individual binding arbitration.

flags.sourceSentence: If you resign or are terminated for cause within twelve (12) months of your start date, the full signing payment becomes repayable within thirty days of your last working day.
flags.consequence: The signer must repay the entire $15,000 signing payment within 30 days of their last working day if they resign or are terminated for cause within the first 12 months, even though the payment was made as a lump sum at the start.

flags.sourceSentence: Ardent may introduce, withdraw, interpret or amend any policy, handbook provision, benefit plan or term of employment described in this letter at any time and without your agreement, and the version in force on the Ardent intranet governs from the date it is published there.
flags.consequence: Ardent can change, withdraw or reinterpret any policy, benefit or term of employment described in the letter at any time without the signer's agreement, so the deal as signed is not locked in.

flags.sourceSentence: On or before your start date you will sign the Employee Confidential Information and Invention Assignment Agreement enclosed with this letter.
flags.consequence: The signer must sign a separate Confidential Information and Invention Assignment Agreement before starting, and its terms — which are not in this document — survive after employment ends, so the signer is agreeing to obligations they cannot yet read in full here.

flags.sourceSentence: The Operator's total liability to the Occupant for any loss of or damage to stored property, however caused, including loss or damage caused by the Operator's own negligence, is limited to five thousand dollars ($5,000) unless the Occupant has declared a higher value on the Unit Schedule and paid the corresponding value protection fee.
flags.consequence: The occupant must carry insurance on everything stored, at full value, and produce proof on request; without it, the occupant bears all risk of loss, and even with it, the operator's liability for any loss or damage — including damage the operator's own negligence causes — is capped at $5,000 unless the occupant declared a higher value and paid a value protection fee.

flags.sourceSentence: The Occupant will indemnify, defend and hold the Operator harmless from every claim, demand, loss, cost and expense, including reasonable attorney fees, brought by any person and arising out of the Occupant's use of the unit or the premises, the property stored in the unit, or the acts of anyone the Occupant allows on to the premises.
flags.consequence: The occupant must pay for and defend against every claim, demand, loss, cost and expense — including attorney fees — brought by anyone arising from the occupant's use of the unit or premises, the stored property, or the acts of anyone the occupant lets onto the premises, with no cap on the amount.

flags.sourceSentence: Where rent or any charge is unpaid, the Operator has a lien on all property stored in the unit and may deny the Occupant access, overlock the unit, and after the notice period the law requires, sell the contents and apply the proceeds to what is owed.
flags.consequence: If rent or any charge is unpaid, the operator claims a lien over everything in the unit, can deny the occupant access and overlock the unit, and after the required notice period can sell the occupant's contents and keep the proceeds to cover what is owed — putting the occupant's stored property at risk over an unpaid charge, not just unpaid rent.

flags.sourceSentence: The Operator may increase the monthly rent on not less than thirty (30) days written notice to the Occupant, and the increased rent is due on the first rent day falling after the notice period ends.
flags.consequence: The monthly rent can be raised on 30 days' written notice, and the occupant must either pay the higher amount or leave, with no cap on how much the rent can increase or how often.

flags.sourceSentence: Rent not received by the sixth day of the month incurs the late charge shown in the Schedule of Charges posted in the ofﬁce and on the Harbour Road website, and each further notice the Operator is required to send about an unpaid balance incurs the administration charge shown in the same schedule.
flags.consequence: Late rent triggers a late charge whose amount is not in this document — it sits in a Schedule of Charges posted in the office and on a website — and every further notice about an unpaid balance adds another administration charge, also in that unseen schedule, so the total cost of a late month is unknown and can grow with each notice.

flags.sourceSentence: Gate hours, the rules posted in the office, and the terms of this Agreement may be changed by the Operator on notice posted at the facility and sent to the Occupant's last known email address, and the changed version applies to the Occupant from the first day of the month after it is posted.
flags.consequence: The operator can unilaterally change the gate hours, the posted rules, and the terms of this agreement itself, with the changes binding the occupant from the first day of the month after they are posted and emailed — so terms the occupant agreed to can be replaced without their signature or consent.

flags.sourceSentence: After the initial term this Agreement continues on a month to month basis, each month renewing on the first day of the month without notice from either party, until it is ended as Section 8 describes.
flags.consequence: After the first month, the agreement renews automatically every month without either party doing anything, so it will not end on its own; the occupant must give written notice at least ten days before the end of a month to stop it, and rent already paid for the move-out month is not refunded.

flags.sourceSentence: Rent already paid for the month in which the Occupant moves out is not refunded.
flags.consequence: The occupant loses the rent they already paid for the month in which they move out, even if they leave early in that month.

flags.sourceSentence: Service on a twelve month promotional plan renews for a further twelve month term at the end of the term then running, at the standard rate for the plan rather than at the promotional rate, unless you tell us to stop the renewal before the last day of the current term.
flags.consequence: If you sign up for a twelve-month promotional plan and do not cancel the renewal before the last day of the current term, you are committed to another full twelve-month term at the standard rate rather than the promotional rate, which could be a materially higher price for up to a year.

flags.sourceSentence: Cancelling a promotional plan before the end of its term does not cancel a device instalment plan, and the unpaid instalment balance becomes due in full on your next bill.
flags.consequence: If you cancel a promotional plan before its term ends, the entire unpaid balance on your device instalment plan becomes due immediately on your next bill, which could be a large lump sum.

flags.sourceSentence: You and Cascade agree that any dispute arising out of or relating to this Agreement, the service or any device will be resolved by individual binding arbitration administered by a nationally recognised arbitration provider under its consumer rules, and both of us give up the right to a jury trial and the right to bring or join a class, collective or representative action.
flags.consequence: You give up the right to a jury trial and the right to bring or join a class, collective or representative action, so a serious dispute (for example over billing or service) could only be pursued as an individual arbitration, without the leverage of a group claim.

flags.sourceSentence: Your bill includes a Regulatory Cost Recovery Charge and an Administrative Charge, neither of which is a tax or a charge required by any government, and Cascade may introduce, increase or remove either charge on notice given with the bill in which the change ﬁrst appears.
flags.consequence: The bill includes a Regulatory Cost Recovery Charge and an Administrative Charge that are not government-required, and Cascade can introduce, increase or remove either charge on notice given with the bill where the change first appears, so your monthly cost can rise with little warning.

flags.sourceSentence: An amount not paid by the due date shown on the bill incurs a late payment charge of the greater of five dollars ($5.00) or one and one half percent of the unpaid balance, applied each bill period until the balance is paid, and a restored line incurs the restoral charge shown in the Rate and Charge Guide.
flags.consequence: An unpaid balance accrues a late charge of the greater of $5.00 or 1.5% of the unpaid balance every bill period until paid, so the charge compounds on a lingering balance, and restoring a suspended line adds a restoral charge set in a Rate and Charge Guide you were not given.

flags.sourceSentence: Cascade may change any term of this Agreement, any charge, and any feature of your rate plan, and the change takes effect on the date stated in the notice we give you, which may be given on a bill, by message to your device, or by email.
flags.consequence: Cascade can change any term, charge or feature of your rate plan on notice (which can be given on a bill, by device message or by email), and keeping using the service after the effective date means you have accepted the change, so the price and terms you signed up for are not locked in.

flags.sourceSentence: Cascade’s entire liability to you for any claim relating to the service, a device, or this Agreement, whether the claim is made in contract, in negligence, in warranty or under any statute, is limited to the service charges applied to the affected line during the bill period in which the claim arose, and Cascade is not liable for lost profits, lost data, or any indirect or consequential loss.
flags.consequence: If Cascade is at fault for a problem with the service or a device, the most you could recover under this document is the service charges for the affected line for the single bill period in which the claim arose, and you cannot recover lost profits, lost data, or indirect or consequential loss.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify and hold Cascade harmless from any claim, loss or expense, including reasonable legal fees, arising out of your use of the service, out of anything sent from or stored on your device, out of the use of your line by anyone you allow to use it, and out of any charge incurred on your account.
flags.consequence: You must cover Cascade's claims, losses and expenses, including legal fees, arising from your use of the service, anything sent from or stored on your device, anyone you allow to use your line, and any charge on your account, which is open-ended and could exceed what you pay for the service.

flags.sourceSentence: Data speeds on an unlimited plan may be reduced after you use the monthly priority allowance shown on your Service Summary, and reduced speeds continue until the next bill period starts.
flags.consequence: On an unlimited plan, your data speeds drop after you use the monthly priority allowance shown on the Service Summary and stay reduced until the next bill period, so heavy usage in a month gets slower service at the same price.

flags.sourceSentence: Charges accrue to the end of the bill period in which you cancel, and a part bill period is not prorated.
flags.consequence: When you cancel, you keep paying through the end of the current bill period with no proration, so you could pay for up to a month of service you do not use.

flags.sourceSentence: The Firm may end the Programme early for any reason on one week written notice.
flags.consequence: The Firm can end the twelve-week programme at any point for any reason on one week's written notice, cutting off the remaining stipend weeks with no compensation stated in the document.

flags.sourceSentence: The Firm may amend the Programme Handbook, the assessment structure, the teaching schedule and the terms of this Agreement at any time by issuing a revised version to the Analyst by email, and the revised version applies from the date of that email.
flags.consequence: The Firm can change the Handbook, the assessment structure, the teaching schedule and the terms of this agreement itself at any time, with the change taking effect from the date of an email, so the deal the Analyst signed can be altered without their agreement.

flags.sourceSentence: For six (6) months after the Programme ends, the Analyst will not accept an engagement, whether paid or unpaid and whether as an employee, a contractor or an intern, with any firm on the Restricted List issued to the Analyst in week one of the Programme, and will not approach any client of the Firm whose file the Analyst worked on.
flags.consequence: For six months after the programme ends, the Analyst cannot take any engagement, paid or unpaid, with any firm on the Restricted List, and cannot approach clients they worked on, which could block future work or internships; the list is confidential, may be reissued during the programme, and its contents are not in this document.

flags.sourceSentence: The Analyst will indemnify the Firm and hold it harmless against any claim, loss or expense, including reasonable legal costs, arising out of a breach by the Analyst of Section 4 or Section 5, or out of anything the Analyst publishes about the Firm or a client of the Firm.
flags.consequence: The Analyst must pay the Firm's claims, losses, expenses and legal costs arising from any breach of the confidentiality or post-programme restrictions, or from anything the Analyst publishes about the Firm or its clients, an obligation with no stated cap that could exceed the stipend earned.

flags.sourceSentence: Any dispute between the Analyst and the Firm arising out of the Programme or out of this Agreement will be resolved by final and binding arbitration on an individual basis, administered under the employment rules of a nationally recognised provider, and the Analyst gives up any right to a jury trial and any right to bring or join a class or collective action.
flags.consequence: The Analyst gives up the right to a jury trial and the right to bring or join a class or collective action, and must resolve any dispute individually in final and binding arbitration, so serious problems (such as early termination or indemnity claims) could be contested only through a single-arbitration route with no group action.

flags.sourceSentence: Where the Analyst takes the optional housing advance, it is repaid in six equal instalments deducted from the stipend, and any instalment not recovered within ten (10) days of its due date carries the late charge set out in the Programme Handbook until it is repaid in full.
flags.consequence: A late charge, in an amount set in the Programme Handbook (not supplied with this document), is added to each housing-advance instalment not recovered within ten days of its due date, and the charge continues until the advance is repaid in full.

flags.sourceSentence: This obligation has no end date.
flags.consequence: The confidentiality obligation covers every client name, model, memorandum and data set seen during the programme, prohibits keeping any copy, and has no end date, so it binds the Analyst indefinitely after the programme ends.

flags.sourceSentence: An item not returned within five working days is charged at the replacement cost shown in the Programme Handbook.
flags.consequence: If the laptop, security token or building pass is not returned within five working days, the Analyst is charged the replacement cost listed in the Programme Handbook, an amount not stated in this document.

flags.sourceSentence: After the third lesson no refund is made.
flags.consequence: If the family withdraws after the third lesson, the entire $120 fee is kept by the Centre, even for the remaining lessons the child will not attend.

flags.sourceSentence: A place given up later than that, and before the third lesson, is refunded at half the fee.
flags.consequence: Withdrawing between the seven-day deadline and the third lesson returns only $60 of the $120 fee, so the family loses half the fee for a place given up before most lessons have happened.
